title: AUTH-002 Native Session Runtime Evidence Gate
purpose: Define the minimum executable evidence required to prove that the W01 official Cloudflare D1 template Payload 3.82.1 native session identity and lifecycle correlate with the canonical AUTH-002 session contract before runtime promotion.
preconditions: Gate-1 controlled remote D1 schema evidence is accepted for the same tested commit.
W01 dependency set is exactly the contract-pinned official Cloudflare D1 template baseline.
Payload and @payloadcms/db-d1-sqlite are exactly 3.82.1 in workers/W01-payload/package.json and the W01 pnpm lockfile once generated.
Node runtime is the template-compatible Node 24 line.
The runtime test uses a disposable isolated test account/session and never production credentials.
No independent custom session identifier is minted by the evidence harness.

mandatoryCorrelations.loginToSid: The same disposable login operation MUST produce the native Payload sid later used by validation and logout evidence.
mandatoryCorrelations.sidToUser: The native sid MUST resolve to the same authoritative user id observed at login.
mandatoryCorrelations.sidToLifecycle: The same native sid MUST be traceable through validation and logout; the harness MUST NOT substitute another identifier.
mandatoryCorrelations.createdAt: The observed createdAt MUST be native Payload session state, not synthesized application state.
mandatoryCorrelations.expiresAt: The observed expiresAt MUST be native Payload session state and expiration MUST cause denial.
mandatoryCorrelations.extensionKey: auth_session_state.session_id MUST equal the native Payload sid when extension state exists.
mandatoryCorrelations.singleAuthority: Authorization MUST fail closed when native session state and canonical extension state disagree.

negativeCases: canonical revoked state is denied even when stale native authorization material exists
wrong device binding is denied when device binding is present
missing extension state is denied when extension state is required for the tested operation
raw credential material is never persisted, logged, or emitted in evidence
concurrencyRequirements: Two or more concurrent refresh attempts using one predecessor may produce at most one successful successor.
Concurrent logout is idempotent and may not resurrect authorization state.
Concurrent validation must never authorize a revoked canonical session.
stopConditions: The native sid cannot be observed and correlated across lifecycle steps.
createdAt or expiresAt is synthesized rather than observed from native Payload state.
A second independent session identifier is introduced.
Extension state is treated as a replacement for native session identity.
A revoked or expired session can still authorize.
Concurrent refresh produces more than one valid successor.
Logout reports success without required durable revocation state.
Any secret or credential material appears in evidence.
Evidence cannot be tied to the exact tested commit.
Gate-1 evidence is missing, stale, or unaccepted.
